verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison ships an official Python SDK (edison-client, installable via pip). It is documented with an API-key auth flow, a JobNames enum, sync and async task methods (create_task/acreate_task, get_task, run_tasks_until_done), dict-or-model inputs, file and data-storage management, and long-lived chat-session methods. That clearly supports building against it programmatically. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/JS), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK in use.
